title: World Table Tennis Day!
body_html:
Every year, on 23 April, the sporting community around the world celebrates World Table Tennis Day — one of the most popular and widespread sports. Through diversity and inclusion, table tennis offers equal opportunities to everyone, regardless of age, race, gender or physical ability.

Over the past period of the 2023-2024 season, the National Sports Association ATTP organised and ran about 2,000 regular table tennis tournaments, with the best players among the more than 150 members of the largest community of table tennis players in the Republic of Moldova — ATTP.

Also, for the first time in the Republic of Moldova, a MASTERS series tournament of unprecedented scale and class was organised and held, with the best masters of the sport taking part.

And of course, for amateurs in every age category, the seasonal SUPER CUP ATTP tournaments (SUMMER, AUTUMN and WINTER) took place, with the most valuable and exclusive prizes of any similar competitions in the country.

We aim to make table tennis accessible to everyone, in every region of our country, and to that end ATTP promotes table tennis as a timely tool for building unity and dialogue among all members of our large community. The sport inspires people and strengthens their confidence in themselves and their abilities, which makes table tennis a special way of life.

Alongside competitions and media promotion, ATTP is doing everything it can to improve the practical knowledge and qualifications of our players, referees and coaches.

On this occasion, the National Sports Association ATTP sends its sincere congratulations on this wonderful day and wishes everyone who loves table tennis, plays it and belongs to the big ATTP family good health and well-being, new wins and sporting achievements, and success in reaching all their goals!
